caption: One ad, many hands. The ad break only looks like a simple television slot; underneath it, the seller's agent, the ad server, the SSPs, and the buyers divide the hammer price in milliseconds.
alt: A viewer watches a connected TV while a dark auction room behind the screen routes media lots, bid paths, and brass payment tokens through a seller's ledger.
name: scene_ad_break_auction

caption: The decision before the auction. Video ad serving became powerful because it decided what would actually play, a job that made CTV plumbing more strategic than a pure exchange.
alt: Engineers in a dark auction-room machine hall stitch video ad pods through old cable equipment and streaming servers while a seller-agent studies a ledger.
name: scene_video_ad_server

caption: The header that never came. CTV's missing browser layer pushed auction control back toward server-side stitching instead of the open-web header-bidding path.
alt: An auction room splits into an open-web bidding corridor and a central server-side path leading into a television ad pod.
name: scene_roads_not_taken

caption: The lit desks and the curtained booths. The independent roster can be ranked only where companies expose enough CTV evidence for the ledger to be read.
alt: Three brightly lit broker desks with open ledgers sit before several curtained, darker booths in a CTV auction hall.
name: scene_disclosure_roster

after: ## The response: attention, performance, and agentic trading
caption: Three tools for a squeezed commission. Attention signals, outcome claims, and seller agents are the independent SSPs' answer to buyers narrowing the supply path.
alt: A seller-agent coordinates an attention lens, outcome receipts, and abstract software agents from a baize auction desk.
name: scene_response_machine

after: ## Amazon: The Same Company Sits on Both Sides of the Table
caption: The booth on both sides. A platform that owns the screen and the buying tool can make the independent seller's door narrow by design.
alt: A large private trading booth controls both the streaming-screen supply gallery and the buyer bidding desks while an outside seller-agent waits at a side door.
name: scene_platform_two_sides

caption: Required, tolerated, designed out. The independent SSP matters most where a publisher cannot build the stack, less where a platform only needs incremental demand, and least where the platform keeps the auction inside its walls.
alt: Three auction corridors show a small publisher using a broker, a large platform opening a narrow side hatch, and a sealed private stack shutting the broker out.
name: scene_platform_roles

caption: The living room becomes evidence. Attention measurement turns household viewing into a market signal, but the signal depends on which instrument produced it.
alt: A glass-walled living room inside an auction hall is observed by attention instruments while analysts compare the results at baize desks.
name: scene_attention_panel

caption: A useful overlay, not yet a currency. The attention instruments help buyers tell a quality story, but their units still do not balance cleanly on a shared scale.
alt: A seller-agent weighs attention instruments on brass scales while many connected-TV screens glow behind the rostrum.
name: scene_attention_verdict

caption: The household graph. Performance CTV starts by trying to connect the shared television to the phone, browser, and checkout path where the outcome appears.
alt: A connected TV, phone, laptop, checkout terminal, and payment device are linked by solid and faint glowing identity threads over a ledger.
name: scene_identity_linking

after: ### Is the premium bigger than the risk
caption: The seller as underwriter. Outcome guarantees move the uncertainty from the buyer's media plan onto the seller's balance sheet.
alt: A seller-agent balances a large stack of impressions against a smaller stack of outcome receipts while reserve-red loss tickets gather on the desk.
name: scene_outcome_underwriting

caption: Agents above the old rails. The new negotiation layer is only useful if buyer and seller agents can speak across shared protocols built on existing transaction plumbing.
alt: Two abstract luminous software agents negotiate across a brass bridge above an auction floor while human operators step back.
name: scene_agentic_layer

after: ## The Cross-Cutting Shocks That Could Reset the Board by 2029
caption: Forces outside the product roadmap. Privacy law, antitrust remedies, in-housing, measurement fragmentation, and the ad cycle can redraw the board before agentic trading does.
alt: A seller-agent grips a ledger as legal folders, privacy locks, platform doors, measurement meters, and storm clouds pressure a live trading board.
name: scene_shocks_reset_board

caption: Bigger, thinner, fewer. The modal 2029 case leaves the leading independents standing, but with platform stacks looming and commissions under pressure.
alt: Independent auctioneers keep working under giant platform-owned booths while one mid-tier desk is quietly packed away.
name: scene_squeezed_standing

caption: The board can still break. A remedy, privacy ruling, or true agent-to-agent layer could create openings for independents while also producing a stronger new rival.
alt: A CTV auction room reshuffles as a large exchange block separates, privacy threads dim, platform doors move, and new deal rails cross the old lanes.
name: scene_structural_break
